name: retention-agent
description: Pre-churn and win-back retention workflow for Zoho Billing. Detects at-risk subscriptions, classifies cancel reasons, applies a tunable YAML decision matrix (LTV x LTD x reason), and produces a propose-only Markdown recommendation report for human review.

requiredEnv.description: OAuth access token with ZohoSubscriptions.reports.READ scope
Zoho data-centre domain — zoho.com (default) or zoho.in
